## Active

### D-056 — Detail arrays are optional in generated add/edit validation

> _2026-08-18 · core/blong-mock · active_

`crudParams()` in `core/blong-mock` marks sibling detail arrays `Type.Optional` so a master without
details is valid. Without it the RBAC 403 test got a 400 validation error before authorization was
evaluated, which made the test exercise the wrong layer.
